shortDescription: Manage IPSec Traffic Selectors on BIG-IP

options.name: destination_address
options.description: Specifies the host or network IP address to which the application traffic is destined. When creating a new traffic selector, this parameter is required.

options.name: ipsec_policy
options.description: Specifies the IPsec policy that tells the BIG-IP system how to handle the packets. When creating a new traffic selector, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(default-ipsec-policy).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the traffic selector.

options.name: order
options.description: Specifies the order in which traffic is matched, if traffic can be matched to multiple traffic selectors. Traffic is matched to the traffic selector with the highest priority (lowest order number). When creating a new traffic selector, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(last).

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: source_address
options.description: Specifies the host or network IP address from which the application traffic originates. When creating a new traffic selector, this parameter is required.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.
